Valarpirai Muhurtham Dates 2027 – Auspicious Dates & Timings

The traditional auspicious day, like Valarpirai Muhurtham’s date for 2027, has been announced. Here we have listed all the Valarpirai Muhurtham dates, which include verified weekdays and Chennai Muhurtham timings. To learn more about the upcoming Valarpirai Muhurtham for 2027, keep exploring.

What Is Valarpirai Muhurtham?

Valarpirai is a growing phase of the Moon, starting after the new moon and continuing towards the full moon day. Culturally, this Valarpirai symbolises growth and an auspicious beginning for something new. But not every Valarpirai day is a suitable Muhurtham.

Occasions for Valarpirai Muhurtham

Some Valarpirai Muhurtham dates are considered good for doing things like weddings, engagements, housewarmings, openings, and other occasions. Selection depends on the ceremony, tithi, nakshatra, and timing. Before fixing, consider a second opinion from a priest or family astrologer.

Valarpirai Muhurtham vs Theipirai Muhurtham

To differentiate them in a simple way; Valarpirai is a growing phase of the Moon, while Theipirai is a shading phase of the Moon. Traditional practices differ, and both require checking specific Muhurtham conditions before fixing a ceremony date for weddings and other functions.

Valarpirai Dates 2027 – FAQs & Common Questions

When is the next Valarpirai Muhurtham in 2026?

The next Valarpirai Muhurtham in 2027 depends on the current date and verified Chennai Panchangam timings. Check the month-wise calendar above for upcoming auspicious dates.

Is every Valarpirai day auspicious?

No. Valarpirai refers to the waxing Moon phase, but not every day is suitable for auspicious ceremonies. Tithi, nakshatra, weekdays, and other astrological factors must be considered.

Which ceremonies use Valarpirai Muhurtham?

Valarpirai Muhurtham dates are traditionally considered for weddings, engagements, housewarming ceremonies, and other important family functions. The suitable date and timing depend on the specific ceremony.

Do Muhurtham timings vary by location?

Yes. Muhurtham timings can vary depending on location, sunrise time and Panchangam calculations. The timings on this page are based on Chennai and may differ in other cities.
